name: Ellmarch Frame 77 EGEO
description: Key Features Jokulhlaup-Rated River Stage : Engineered to withstand sudden glacial outburst flood events, ensuring resilience and safety in extreme river conditions. Expansive Deck Area : Offers a spacious 782 square metres of usable deck space, ideal for group activities, equipment setup, or events. High Freeboard : Features a 124-centimetre freeboard, providing enhanced protection against water ingress and improving overall stability. Generous Occupancy : Accommodates up to 27 people comfortably, making it suitable for large groups, research teams, or guided tours. Deep Mooring Capability : Supports secure mooring at depths up to 247 metres, allowing for flexible deployment in a wide range of river or reservoir environments. Dynamic Positioning System : Includes advanced station keeping with dynamic positioning, maintaining precise location even in changing water currents or weather conditions. Main Benefits Reliable Safety : Designed to meet stringent safety standards for flood-prone river environments, reducing risk for users and equipment. Versatile Usage : Large deck and high occupancy cater to diverse activities such as scientific research, environmental monitoring, or recreational gatherings. Ease of Deployment : Deep mooring and dynamic positioning simplify setup and ensure stable operation in variable water conditions. Durability and Stability : High freeboard and robust construction provide long-lasting performance and minimize maintenance needs. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Scientific and Environmental Research : Ideal for river monitoring stations, hydrological studies, or flood response operations requiring stable, secure platforms. Group Excursions and Tours : Supports guided river tours, educational outings, or team-building events with ample space and safety features. Event Hosting : Suitable for hosting river-based events or temporary installations where space, safety, and stability are essential. Remote Deployment : Perfect for locations requiring secure, long-term mooring and reliable station keeping, such as remote research outposts or monitoring stations. This river stage is designed for users seeking a robust, flood-resistant platform with ample space and advanced positioning capabilities, addressing needs for safety, reliability, and versatility in demanding riverine environments.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Jokulhlaup-Rated River Stage: Engineered to withstand sudden glacial outburst flood events, ensuring resilience and safety in extreme river conditions.
  • Expansive Deck Area: Offers a spacious 782 square metres of usable deck space, ideal for group activities, equipment setup, or events.
  • High Freeboard: Features a 124-centimetre freeboard, providing enhanced protection against water ingress and improving overall stability.
  • Generous Occupancy: Accommodates up to 27 people comfortably, making it suitable for large groups, research teams, or guided tours.
  • Deep Mooring Capability: Supports secure mooring at depths up to 247 metres, allowing for flexible deployment in a wide range of river or reservoir environments.
  • Dynamic Positioning System: Includes advanced station keeping with dynamic positioning, maintaining precise location even in changing water currents or weather conditions.

Main Benefits

  • Reliable Safety: Designed to meet stringent safety standards for flood-prone river environments, reducing risk for users and equipment.
  • Versatile Usage: Large deck and high occupancy cater to diverse activities such as scientific research, environmental monitoring, or recreational gatherings.
  • Ease of Deployment: Deep mooring and dynamic positioning simplify setup and ensure stable operation in variable water conditions.
  • Durability and Stability: High freeboard and robust construction provide long-lasting performance and minimize maintenance needs.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Scientific and Environmental Research: Ideal for river monitoring stations, hydrological studies, or flood response operations requiring stable, secure platforms.
  • Group Excursions and Tours: Supports guided river tours, educational outings, or team-building events with ample space and safety features.
  • Event Hosting: Suitable for hosting river-based events or temporary installations where space, safety, and stability are essential.
  • Remote Deployment: Perfect for locations requiring secure, long-term mooring and reliable station keeping, such as remote research outposts or monitoring stations.

This river stage is designed for users seeking a robust, flood-resistant platform with ample space and advanced positioning capabilities, addressing needs for safety, reliability, and versatility in demanding riverine environments.
